title: How Prompt Caching Works
youtubeTitle: How Prompt Caching Works — Without Re-Sending Everything
youtubeDescription: A visual explanation of how a reusable prompt prefix is stored, matched, reused and eventually expires.

scenes.voiceText: First, the system prompt is stored inside a reusable memory rail.

sceneDirection.narrativePurpose: Explain how the stable system prompt becomes a reusable cached prefix.
sceneDirection.visualIntent: The viewer sees a large prompt cartridge enter a physical memory rail and lock into place.
sceneDirection.visualMetaphor: A translucent data cartridge docks into a precision memory rail.

camera.path: Track the cartridge from the edge of frame into the open rail, then push toward the locking mechanism.

composition.negativeSpace: Keep the lower-right third clear; captions sit low only while the cartridge action stays in the upper-middle.

environment.atmosphere: A quiet precision-storage chamber with a soft violet horizon.

visualEvent.setup: The memory rail is empty and the prompt cartridge waits just outside it.
visualEvent.action: The cartridge slides along the rail and engages with a mechanical latch.
visualEvent.payoff: The cartridge remains seated and its lock indicator illuminates, showing that the prefix is now stored.

elements.purpose: Represents the reusable system prompt being stored.
elements.motionRole: Moves into the rail, rotates into alignment and settles when the latch engages.

elements.purpose: Shows the reusable cache location that keeps the stable prefix available.
elements.motionRole: Illuminates along its length as the cartridge reaches the docking point.

elements.purpose: Makes the stored state visually unambiguous.
elements.motionRole: Rotates and changes from dim violet to bright lime when storage completes.

trigger.anchor: stored inside a reusable memory rail

choreography.pathOrChange: Slide right into the rail, rotate from -12 degrees to zero and settle at the slot.
choreography.purpose: Make storage a visible physical event.

causeAndEffect.reaction: The rail lights in sequence and the lock indicator rotates into its engaged state.

soundCue.purpose: A tactile latch click marks the exact moment storage succeeds.

audio.voiceSegment: First, the system prompt is stored inside a reusable memory rail.
audio.ambience: A faint low mechanical hum follows the physical storage chamber; no extra music is needed in this beat.
audio.musicCue: No separate music in this beat; preserve the sense of precision and focus.
audio.ducking: Voice is foreground. Keep the latch transient short and below speech.

transition.continuityReason: The illuminated lock becomes the scanner ring in the next shot, carrying the stored-prefix idea forward.

scenes.voiceText: Next, the incoming request is scanned to find the prefix it already shares.

sceneDirection.narrativePurpose: Show that a new request can be checked against the prefix already stored.
sceneDirection.visualIntent: A request packet enters a scanning field; a moving scan ring passes over it and identifies the matching prefix.
sceneDirection.visualMetaphor: A top-down inspection scanner compares the request packet with a stored signature.

camera.path: Descend from above and rotate slightly as the scanning ring moves across the request.

composition.negativeSpace: Place captions in the lower-left quadrant, away from the scanner sweep.

environment.atmosphere: A clean dark inspection surface with subtle grid depth.

visualEvent.setup: A request packet arrives above a stored prefix signature.
visualEvent.action: A scanner ring travels across the packet; matching segments light in sequence.
visualEvent.payoff: The matched prefix remains illuminated while the unmatched request tail is isolated.

elements.purpose: Represents the new request being checked for a reusable prefix.
elements.motionRole: Moves into the scanning area and pauses under the ring.

elements.purpose: Shows the scan that looks for the matching prefix.
elements.motionRole: Travels across the request and pulses when a matching segment is found.

elements.purpose: Shows the result of prefix comparison.
elements.motionRole: Turns lime and expands when the scan identifies the cached prefix.

choreography.pathOrChange: Sweep left-to-right across the request packet, scaling up slightly as it passes the matching segment.

causeAndEffect.reaction: The shared prefix glows blue-white and the match indicator turns lime.

soundCue.purpose: A restrained tick marks the precise match result.

audio.voiceSegment: Next, the incoming request is scanned to find the prefix it already shares.
audio.ambience: Use near-silence while the scanner moves so the comparison stays clear.
audio.musicCue: No separate music; the scan tick marks the result.
audio.ducking: Voice remains primary; the tick is short and does not mask the final words.

scenes.voiceText: Instead of sending that repeated prefix again, only the new request takes the fast path.

sceneDirection.narrativePurpose: Explain the practical effect of a cache hit: only the uncached part needs to continue through the system.
sceneDirection.visualIntent: A small new-request packet races through a dedicated fast lane while the cached prefix stays docked and still.
sceneDirection.visualMetaphor: A side-view data tunnel where the cached payload stays parked and the new request travels through a fast lane.

camera.path: Track alongside the moving request packet through the tunnel; hold the cached rail in the near background.

composition.negativeSpace: Keep the upper-right third free for captions; the request packet travels through the center-left corridor.

environment.atmosphere: A deep data tunnel with directional perspective lines.

visualEvent.setup: The cached prefix is already parked in memory while a new request approaches.
visualEvent.action: The new request packet enters a bright fast lane and accelerates past the stationary cache rail.
visualEvent.payoff: The request exits the tunnel without moving the stored prefix, showing that the repeated portion was reused.

elements.purpose: Represents the repeated prefix that remains stored and is not sent again.
elements.motionRole: Remains docked and steady while the request moves past.

elements.purpose: Shows the optimized route taken by the new part of the request.
elements.motionRole: Brightens and pulses from the entry point to the exit.

elements.purpose: Represents only the new request data that still needs to be transmitted.
elements.motionRole: Accelerates through the fast lane and exits toward the right edge.

trigger.anchor: only the new request takes the fast path

choreography.pathOrChange: Move left-to-right along the tunnel, increase scale slightly and accelerate toward the exit.
choreography.purpose: Show the remaining request data travelling after the cache hit.

causeAndEffect.reaction: The path lights sequentially while the cached prefix remains motionless.

soundCue.purpose: A short directional whoosh reinforces the packet's acceleration.

audio.ducking: Narration stays foregrounded; the whoosh is brief and tucked below the voice.

scenes.voiceText: When the cache expires, the stored prompt is released and a future request must store it again.

sceneDirection.narrativePurpose: Explain that cached prompt storage has a lifetime and must be refreshed after expiration.
sceneDirection.visualIntent: A memory cartridge sits inside a rotating expiry ring; the ring completes, the lock disengages and the cartridge ejects.
sceneDirection.visualMetaphor: A physical memory capsule inside a circular countdown mechanism.

camera.path: Orbit around the storage capsule as the countdown ring closes, then crane down as the cartridge ejects.

composition.negativeSpace: Place captions in the upper-left arc, outside the rotating ring and ejection path.

environment.atmosphere: A quiet chamber with a single rotating timing mechanism.

visualEvent.setup: A stored prompt is secure inside a glowing countdown ring.
visualEvent.action: The countdown ring closes, the lock indicator dims and the cartridge is pushed out.
visualEvent.payoff: The rail is empty again, showing that an expired cache must be stored on a later request.

elements.purpose: Represents the cache lifetime reaching its end.
elements.motionRole: Rotates and tightens around the memory capsule before completion.

elements.purpose: Represents the cached prompt that is released when its lifetime ends.
elements.motionRole: Stays centered until the lock releases, then moves outward along the ejection path.

elements.purpose: Signals that the stored cache has expired.
elements.motionRole: Changes from steady amber to a brief flash as the capsule unlocks.

choreography.pathOrChange: Rotate the ring one final quarter turn and contract its radius slightly.
choreography.purpose: Show the cache lifetime reaching its end.

causeAndEffect.reaction: The expiry indicator flashes and the prompt capsule unlocks.

soundCue.purpose: A restrained ratchet click marks the expiration point.

choreography.pathOrChange: Eject the capsule outward and slightly down, leaving the ring empty.
choreography.purpose: Make cache expiration and release visible.

causeAndEffect.reaction: The countdown ring fades back to its empty waiting state.

soundCue.purpose: A short reverse-moving whoosh accompanies the stored capsule leaving the cache.

audio.voiceSegment: When the cache expires, the stored prompt is released and a future request must store it again.
audio.ambience: Keep the countdown chamber nearly silent so the expiry click is clear.
audio.musicCue: A restrained tension rise resolves at the empty rail; no constant loop.
audio.ducking: Voice remains clear above all transient sounds; duck any future music under speech.
